contracts.recipeAuthority: Execute the selected rewardProfile exactly once per actual source; wheel context/budget/lore mirrors never grant again.
contracts.universalSelectors: Elemental Slime calls existing element-universal once. Cosmic Warrior no longer calls the generic power-cosmic wheel; only selected media profile executes.
contracts.fixedPowers: Fixed group grants except Saint/Lantern: those parents grant no power, then exactly one actual armor/ring result grants its conditional power. Ultraman parent grants once and color gives stats only.
contracts.mastery: All early grants survive normal main None and use exactly one shared Power Mastery; no new mastery bonus/max/Enchant.
contracts.bonuses: Register each numeric stat modifier at source and calculate at final bonus phase; total Centaur animal stat points1 or2. Cosmic non-Ultra gets2 points; Ultra color gets2 points.
contracts.raceHistory: All three canonical families participate in global usedRaceFamilyIds and every canonical race invocation; no extra family exclusions.
contracts.size: One global Size, reference/body metrics pending. Centaur lower animal changes body identity only, no second Race/animal/Size spin. Ultraman membership does not invoke Raksasa or give an automatic53m body.
contracts.cosmicSizeReward: Existing >planet Size power-cosmic reward remains independent, once per character under its original guard.
contracts.context: Stack only actual committed family/subtype/group/armor/color, exact selected power tier/binding and source-ledger facts; never reveal future or unselected outcomes.
contracts.funnyResults: No new Shrek funny-result tags in these catalogs; caption humor is not another mechanics trigger.
contracts.identityOnlyCallers: Slayer/Warlord stop Cosmic at group before Ultraman color, Saint armor or Lantern ring; these are reward selectors, not victim/troop identity selectors. Preserve identity-only Slime Element cap differences.
contracts.returnTo: Restore exact saved caller; initial gate only after complete outer Race chain.
contracts.powerTierIndependence: Tier never forces numeric main stats or maximum mastery. Alien X uses canonical Reality Rewrite5; other exact refs use catalog ratings.
contracts.migration: Retired draft fixed-Centaur/one-generic-Cosmic+1Str/+1Dur never execute in new runs. Preserve historical committed journals and prior snapshot.
